name: local-llm
description: Read-only MCP tools (analyze, summarize, review diff, suggest tests) backed by a local Ollama model

ollama_model.title: Ollama model
ollama_model.description: Model name available in your Ollama install (for example qwen2.5-coder:7b or qwen3:4b-instruct)

ollama_base_url.title: Ollama URL
ollama_base_url.description: Ollama API endpoint. Must be local or on a private network; source text is sent to it
